quests.dispatcherQuestion: A stadium's floodlights have failed during an evening match with forty thousand fans inside. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what secondary system should switch on.
quests.explanation: Backup lighting prevents a dangerous crush in the dark while fans find their way to the exits calmly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Stewards report the exits are becoming crowded as fans leave in the low light. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be done to ease the crowding.
quests.explanation: Opening every exit spreads the crowd across more routes, easing pressure at any single doorway.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Power engineers confirm the floodlights are fixed and the stadium is fully lit again. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can switch back once power is restored.
quests.explanation: Switching back to normal lighting once confirmed safe lets the venue return to its usual operation.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A house fire has spread to a garage where several gas canisters are stored. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the safety priority given the risk of explosion.
quests.explanation: Gas canisters can explode without warning in heat, so crews must stay a safe distance back.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Neighbors within fifty meters of the garage need to be moved to safety. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be done with people close by.
quests.explanation: Moving neighbors back protects them from flying debris if one of the canisters does explode.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The canisters have been safely cooled by crews using a remote water jet. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what crews can now safely do.
quests.explanation: Crews can move in to finish extinguishing the fire once the explosion risk has been brought under control.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A cruise ship passenger has a suspected heart attack while docked at a small island port. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask for help urgently, using the word 'now'.
quests.explanation: A local ambulance can get him to hospital faster than trying to sail to a bigger port.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The island's small hospital lacks the equipment to treat a serious heart attack. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask for transport that can reach a bigger hospital fast.
quests.explanation: Air evacuation can get him to a fully equipped hospital far faster than any boat or road route.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A medical helicopter has landed and the patient is stable enough to be moved. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the specific action needed to complete the transfer.
quests.explanation: A careful, direct transfer gets him safely aboard for the flight to proper cardiac care.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A block of shops has a strong smell of burning plastic with no visible flames yet. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what needs to happen before anything else.
quests.explanation: Finding the source first tells crews exactly where and how serious the hidden fire risk really is.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Firefighters trace the smell to overheating wiring inside a locked electrical cupboard. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what must be switched off at the source.
quests.explanation: Cutting power to that specific circuit removes the heat source before it can turn into an open fire.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The wiring has cooled safely and an electrician confirms no fire risk remains. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the risk is confirmed gone.
quests.explanation: Restoring power only after an electrician's confirmation avoids restarting the very fault that caused the problem.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A minibus carrying a school sports team has skidded off an icy rural road. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say what's needed given a bus full of children.
quests.explanation: With many children involved, several ambulances allow paramedics to check each one properly and quickly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The road is too icy for standard ambulances to reach the crash site safely. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what kind of vehicle can handle the icy road.
quests.explanation: A four-wheel-drive response vehicle can reach the scene safely where a normal ambulance might skid off too.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: All the children have been checked and only minor bruises were found. Input code!
quests.hint: Say who needs to be told the good news urgently.
quests.explanation: Contacting parents quickly stops worry from spreading before they hear reliable, accurate information.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A retail warehouse's sprinkler system has burst, flooding the storage floor with shelving units at risk. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what must be stopped at the source.
quests.explanation: Shutting off the faulty sprinkler system stops more water damage while the real cause is checked.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Staff report water is now close to an area storing chemical cleaning supplies. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be relocated urgently.
quests.explanation: Moving the chemicals away from the water prevents a dangerous reaction between the two.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The floor has been cleared of standing water and the chemicals are safely stored elsewhere. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the floor is confirmed safe.
quests.explanation: Reopening the floor once both hazards are resolved lets normal warehouse work safely resume.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A hot air balloon has drifted low and struck power lines during a countryside festival. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what must be switched off at the source.
quests.explanation: Cutting the power removes the risk of electrocution to the balloon's passengers and anyone nearby.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The balloon's basket is caught but the passengers cannot climb down safely alone. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask for the specialists trained for this exact rescue.
quests.explanation: A trained rescue team can bring the passengers down safely using proper harnesses and ladders.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: All four passengers are safely on the ground with only minor scrapes. Input code!
quests.hint: Say who can check on them without a full ambulance.
quests.explanation: First aid staff can quickly treat minor scrapes and confirm nobody needs a hospital visit.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A crowded night market has a stall fire that's spreading quickly between wooden stands. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to the crowd right away.
quests.explanation: Clearing the crowd immediately is the priority, since wooden stalls close together can let fire spread fast.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Firefighters need to know which direction the fire is spreading to plan their approach. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what information crews urgently need.
quests.explanation: Knowing the wind direction tells firefighters exactly where the fire will spread next and how to fight it.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The fire is fully out and market organizers want to know when stalls can reopen. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what must happen before any stall reopens.
quests.explanation: An inspection first ensures no hidden embers remain that could reignite once stalls are back in use.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A tour group is stuck on a cable car that has stopped between two mountain stations. Input code!
quests.hint: Name the trained team this situation needs.
quests.explanation: A trained team can safely reach a stopped cable car using specialist rope and harness equipment.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers confirm a technical fault, not a cable problem, caused the cable car to stop. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be attempted once the fault is understood.
quests.explanation: Restarting only once the specific fault is identified avoids risking a second, more dangerous stoppage.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The cable car has safely reached the station and all passengers are unloading calmly. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be confirmed to close out the call.
quests.explanation: A final confirmation makes sure everyone from the stopped cabin is accounted for before crews stand down.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large indoor market's roof has partially collapsed after heavy snowfall overnight. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to everyone inside right away.
quests.explanation: Evacuating immediately protects shoppers and stallholders from any further part of the weakened roof coming down.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A structural engineer needs to assess how much of the remaining roof is safe. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask for the specialist trained to judge this.
quests.explanation: Only a structural engineer can properly judge whether the rest of the roof is safe to work under.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The engineer confirms the back half of the market is stable and safe to enter. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what partial access can now be granted.
quests.explanation: Allowing access only to the confirmed safe section balances getting back to normal with genuine safety.
